knowledge_planes.name: Knowledge (The Planes)
knowledge_planes.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Knowledge (the planes) gives +2 on Survival checks on other planes. Identifies Outsiders and Elementals.

actions.name: Identify Outsider or Elemental
actions.description: Recall true names, damage reductions, planar alignments, and elemental vulnerabilities (DC 15 + creature HD).

actions.name: Identify Planar Portal or Astral Rift
actions.description: Determine the destination plane, planar traits, gravity mechanics, and key required to open an interdimensional gate.
